description: Sends the host's answer to exactly one participant question by email and marks the question as answered in the live console. Side effect: it sends a real email to that participant from the host's site and writes the answer into the console; nothing else changes. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `question_id` and `answer`. `question_id` comes from wi_get_webinar_questions, never from memory. The answer goes out as the host wrote it, so read it back to them before sending when they spoke it out loud. `subject` is optional. For deleting a question use wi_delete_webinar_question.

answer.description: The host's answer, as it should be read by the participant.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

subject.description: The subject of the answer email. Leave it out and the site uses its own.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_answer_webinar_question
title: Answer one participant question by email
